sections.title: 1. Organizer and purpose
body: These terms of sale govern the sale of admission tickets to LA TEUF nights, organized by LA TEUF ÉLECTRONIQUE (the "organizer") in Lomé (Togo) and Cotonou (Benin).
They apply to any order placed on lateufelectronic.com. Tickets can still be sold on site on the night, subject to availability.
By confirming an order, the buyer acknowledges having read and accepted these terms.

sections.title: 2. Tickets and prices
body: Prices are in CFA francs (FCFA). For the KARMA night (20 November 2026), online sales open on 9 November. Individual tickets are limited to 100 per night.
Early bird: 5,000 FCFA, 70 tickets, on sale from 9 November until the quota is sold out, with no end date.

Standard: 8,000 FCFA, 30 tickets, on sale only once the 70 early birds are sold. Online early bird and standard sales close on the day of the night: remaining tickets are sold at the door, while places last.

Tables: 4 lounges for 6 people are offered on top of the 100 tickets, at 80,000 FCFA per table from 9 to 17 November, then 100,000 FCFA per table from 18 to 20 November. A table comes with 6 individual tickets.
An order includes at most 10 tickets.
A group discount is applied automatically to the standard ticket: −10% from 5 tickets, −15% from 8 tickets, −20% for 10 tickets.
Promo codes do not apply to early birds or tables. They cannot be combined with the group discount: the most favorable discount is applied.

sections.title: 3. Order and ticket reservation
body: As soon as the form is submitted, the tickets are held for 10 minutes. Without payment within this time, the reservation is cancelled and the tickets are put back on sale.
The buyer can cancel the reservation and return to the form at any time before payment.
The order is final only once payment is confirmed.

sections.title: 4. Payment
body: Payment is made online by Mobile Money (Flooz, T-Money, MTN, Moov) or by Visa or Mastercard card, through the secure Kkiapay platform. A robot check is required before payment.
If a payment is received when tickets are no longer available, notably after the reservation has expired, it is refunded.

sections.title: 5. Electronic tickets
body: After payment, each place produces an electronic ticket with a unique QR code, sent by email and WhatsApp to the details provided. The buyer checks that this information is correct.
The QR code is single-use: only the first scan at the entrance is accepted. The buyer must not share or copy the ticket; the organizer is not responsible for the use of a QR code shared by the buyer.
If a ticket is not received, the buyer contacts the organizer.

sections.title: 6. Access to the night
body: The ticket grants access to the night on the date and at the venue shown, within the venue's capacity.
The organizer may refuse entry to or remove anyone who does not follow the rules of the night, notably respect for others and their boundaries.

sections.title: 7. Cancellation, postponement and refunds
body: Tickets are neither exchangeable nor refundable, except if the organizer cancels the night: they are then refunded.
If the night is postponed, tickets remain valid for the new date.

sections.title: 8. Personal data
body: The information requested when ordering (name, email, WhatsApp number, country) is used to process the order and send the tickets. How it is handled is detailed in the privacy policy.

sections.title: 9. Contact
body: For any question about an order: hello@lateufelectronic.com, or by phone at +228 91 95 01 93 (Shayn) and +228 93 70 62 42 (booking, AK2M).

sections.title: 1. Data controller
body: LA TEUF ÉLECTRONIQUE is the controller of the personal data collected on lateufelectronic.com. Contact: hello@lateufelectronic.com.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
body: When you order tickets: name, email address, WhatsApp number, country of residence, the content and amount of the order, and the payment transaction identifier.
When you browse: IP address and technical connection data (security, anti-bot check, operating statistics), and a 30-day attribution cookie if you arrive through a partner's link.
We do not collect card numbers or Mobile Money codes: payment details are entered with Kkiapay.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
body: Processing your order, issuing and emailing your tickets, and controlling entry to the night (performance of the contract).
Contacting you about your order, a refund or a change to the night (performance of the contract and legitimate interest).
Protecting the site against abuse and fraud with an anti-bot check (legitimate interest).
Measuring sales from partner links and calculating their commission (legitimate interest).

sections.title: 4. Recipients and processors
body: Your data is accessible to the LA TEUF team and to the following providers, only to deliver the service: Kkiapay (payment), Supabase (database), Resend (email delivery), Cloudflare Turnstile (anti-bot check) and Vercel (hosting).
Some of these providers are located outside Togo and Benin, notably in the European Union and the United States. We do not sell your data.

sections.title: 5. Retention
body: Order data is kept for [To be completed] (proposed: 3 years after the night, then deleted or anonymised). Payment data held by Kkiapay follows their own policy.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
body: The site only uses strictly necessary cookies: the chosen language and, where applicable, partner-link attribution (30 days). It uses no advertising cookies and no third-party tracking.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
body: You may request access to, correction or erasure of your data, or restriction of or objection to its processing, by writing to hello@lateufelectronic.com. We reply within a reasonable time, after verifying your identity.
You may also contact the data protection authority of your country ([To be completed]: Togo or Benin).

sections.title: 8. Security
body: Communication with the site is encrypted (HTTPS). Tickets carry a unique, signed QR code valid until the end of the day after the night. Only share your QR code with the person who will use it.

sections.title: 9. Changes
body: This policy may change; the date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.

Faq.title: Your questions, our answers
Faq.intro: Tickets, tables, payment, getting in: everything you need to know before stepping through the portal.
Faq.ctaText: The team replies by email as soon as possible. You can also call us or message us on social media.

items.q: What is LA TEUF?
items.a: A festive electronic music gathering in Lomé and Cotonou to break the routine: DJs, live instrumentalists and carefully crafted staging, in a warm atmosphere open to everyone. One night a month, venues that change, always the same energy.

items.q: When is the next night?
items.a: LA TEUF at KARMA, in Lomé (Togo), on 20 November 2026. The next one is in Cotonou (Benin) on 12 December 2026: the venue and line-up will be announced soon. All dates are on the Events page.

items.q: Who is playing?
items.a: The DJs and live instrumentalists of each night are presented on the DJs page. When a line-up is not announced yet, it will be on the site and on our social media.

items.q: What is the vibe? Are there rules?
items.a: A free, warm and relaxed party, with respect for everyone and their limits. The organizer may refuse entry to, or remove, anyone who does not respect others.

items.q: How many people can the night hold?
items.a: The KARMA night is limited to 100 individual tickets, plus 4 tables of 6 people. When it is sold out, it is sold out: do not wait too long.

items.q: When do KARMA ticket sales open?
items.a: Online sales open on 9 November 2026, on the night's Tickets page: early bird tickets and tables are available from that date.

items.q: What are the prices?
items.a: Early bird: 5,000 FCFA, 70 tickets, on sale from 9 November until sold out. Standard: 8,000 FCFA, 30 tickets, open only once the 70 early birds are sold. The standard ticket stays visible, greyed out, until then.

items.q: What happens when early birds sell out?
items.a: As soon as the 70th early bird is sold (or held), the 8,000 FCFA standard ticket opens automatically, for 30 tickets. There is no date: it depends on how fast early birds sell. If an early bird booking expires unpaid, the place goes back to early bird.

items.q: Are there group discounts?
items.a: Yes, on the standard ticket: −10% from 5 tickets, −15% from 8 tickets and −20% for 10 tickets. The discount is applied automatically, no code needed, as soon as standard tickets are open (after the 70 early birds).

items.q: How many tickets can I buy at once?
items.a: Up to 10 tickets per order. For a bigger group, place several orders while places remain, or book a table.

items.q: How do I use a promo code?
items.a: Enter it in the “Promo code” field of the booking form, or use the shared link that comes with the code, which fills it in. It does not apply to early birds or tables and cannot be combined with the group discount: the most favorable discount is applied.

items.q: Can I buy tickets on the day of the night?
items.a: Yes. On the day of the night, online early bird and standard sales are closed and remaining tickets are sold at the door, while places last. To be sure of your spot (and the best price), buy online beforehand.

items.q: What is a table?
items.a: A reserved lounge for 6 people at the KARMA night. There are 4 in total, on top of the 100 individual tickets.

items.q: How much is a table?
items.a: 80,000 FCFA per table from 9 to 17 November, then 100,000 FCFA from 18 to 20 November. Book early for the best price.

items.q: How are the tickets of a table sent?
items.a: A table comes with 6 individual tickets, one per person, each with its own QR code. They all arrive at the booking email address: pass them on to your guests.

items.q: Do promo codes work on tables?
items.a: No, neither promo codes nor the group discount apply to tables.

items.q: I have a question about the lounge or its location.
items.a: Write to us on the Contact page or call us before booking: we will gladly answer.

items.q: How can I pay?
items.a: Online, with Mobile Money (Flooz, T-Money, MTN, Moov) or a Visa or Mastercard card, through the secure Kkiapay platform. An anti-bot check is requested just before payment.

items.q: How long are my places held?
items.a: 10 minutes from the moment you submit the form. Without payment in that time, the booking is cancelled and the places go back on sale. You can also cancel and return to the form at any time before paying.

items.q: My payment failed, what now?
items.a: Your places stay held during the countdown: click “Pay” to try again, with another payment method if needed. Also check the balance of your Mobile Money account or card.

items.q: I paid but my time had run out.
items.a: If places are still available, your ticket is issued as usual. Otherwise your payment is refunded: contact us with the order reference shown on screen.

items.q: How do I receive my tickets?
items.a: After payment, each place gets an electronic ticket with a unique QR code, sent by email and WhatsApp to the details you gave. Double-check them when booking.

items.q: I did not receive my ticket.
items.a: First check your spam folder. Otherwise contact us with your name, email and order reference: we will send it again.

items.q: How does entry work?
items.a: Show your ticket's QR code at the door, on your phone or printed. It is single use: only the first scan is accepted. Do not share or copy it; keep it to yourself.

items.q: How long is my ticket valid?
items.a: Until the end of the day after the night. After that, the QR code is refused.

items.q: Can I get a refund or exchange my ticket?
items.a: Tickets are neither exchangeable nor refundable, unless the night is cancelled: they are then refunded. If the night is postponed, tickets remain valid for the new date.

items.q: How do I not forget the date?
items.a: On the confirmation page, add the night to your calendar (Google Calendar, Apple or Outlook): you will get a reminder the day before.

items.q: How can I reach you?
items.a: Through the form on the Contact page, by email at hello@lateufelectronic.com, by phone at +228 91 95 01 93, or on Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp.

items.q: How does the influencer program work?
items.a: Partner influencers get a personal link and follow their sales in a dedicated space. To become a partner, write to us on the Contact page.

items.q: What do you do with my data?
items.a: Name, email, WhatsApp and country are only used to process your order and send you your tickets. Everything is detailed in the privacy policy.
